info.author: xcode
info.comment: Flat vector UI chrome: status chip. A small navy #1B3A6B pill shape with a white inner stroke and a tiny blue #2F6FED square on the left like a status lamp. No text, no letters, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, clean geometric lines, isolated on light gray #E6EBF2.
